text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — we need a compact 30m design review for the API + SDK + Console UX integration (RFC-314). Goal: align on surface-level API shape, SDK ergonomics, and the console flow for rollout. Can people +1 availability and call out any must-have pre-read items by EOD Wed?

ben: +1. I can do Wed 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 09:00–09:30 PT. Is this a working session or just sign-off?

sarah: Working session with quick walkthroughs (15m), 10m decision area, 5m actions. I can run the walkthroughs.

leah: I can join both slots; I’ll capture notes and follow-ups. Add me for UX screenshots.

ravi: Heads-up — on-call Thurs morning. Thu 09 PT might be tight. Prefer Wed afternoon PT (3p PT) if that fits others.

michael: Wed 3p PT is hard for me (calendar clash). Thu 09 PT works.

ben: If we need to pick one, Thu 09 PT is fine from my side.

sarah: Ok — doing a quick availability poll. Please mark your preferred slot here: https://cal.com/redwood/30m-design-compact (pick one) — will send final invite based on poll by EOD.

sarah: Pre-read checklist (pls paste any missing items). Quick checklist:
```
- RFC link: internal: /rfc/314 (section 2 = API surface)
- Minimal example flows: console -> API -> SDK usage snippet (include error path)
- Backcompat notes for v1 -> v2 changes
- Expected perf/latency SLOs and any known risks
- UX mocks for new Console panel (desktop + mobile)
- API schema draft (OpenAPI snippet or pseudo)
- Test plan: e2e + unit + smoke test for rollout
- Suggested canary plan and fallback steps
```

leah: Added UX mocks to the doc and left comments on the Console panel flow. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/rfc-314-prep (updated). :pencil2:

ravi: Added on-call note to poll responses. If we land Thu, I can attend the latter half via phone and contribute to rollout checklist.

deploy-bot: Poll created by sarah — 6 options, closes in 24h. (automated)

ben: Quick ask — can someone paste the minimal SDK snippet here so I can comment on ergonomics?

sarah: Sure — draft snippet below: 
```js
// minimal SDK usage (draft)
import RedwoodSDK from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = new RedwoodSDK({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
const resp = await client.generate({model: 'rw-large-1', prompt: 'Summarize...'});
console.log(resp.text);
```

ben: Nice. One thought: consider `client.generate({})` returning an async iterator for streaming tokens — i'll add a comment in the doc.

leah: FYI I opened a small UX issue: header overlaps on narrow panels — noted in doc.

sarah: Great — action items before the review (please ack):
- skim pre-read doc + leave comments (sarah)
- add any critical compatibility blockers (everyone)
- ben: add ergonomics notes on streaming iterator
- leah: confirm screenshot variants for mobile vs desktop
- ravi: confirm on-call constraints in poll
If no objections, I'll finalize the calendar invite Thu 09:00 PT and attach the pre-read doc. :thumbsup:

michael: :+1: sounds good, thanks for coordinating.

ben: ACK. I'll review pre-read after standup tomorrow.

leah: ACK — will finalize screenshots by EOD.

ravi: ACK — marking poll and will join what I can.

sarah: Thanks — will post final invite in this thread once poll closes. If anyone has blockers pls DM.

sarah: (closing note) If the poll strongly favors Wed 3p PT, i'll reach out to michael to see if he can make a quick swap or send an async summary.
